The period brought one Purview update: the AI and Copilot guidance now presents recommendations more directly and adds a Summary section covering Purview’s role in understanding data, protecting sensitive information, investigating risks, and governing AI interactions.

item.title: Purview DLP guidance names Cowork while DSPM documents Copilot label-inheritance limits — 10 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 10 November 2026

Purview DLP guidance names Cowork while DSPM documents Copilot label-inheritance limits

Cowork is the day's main thread: DLP guidance now calls the location “Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork,” adds Cowork to setup examples and supported experiences, and states that administrative-unit scoping applies to Cowork for Microsoft Copilot and Chat. DSPM guidance defines when new Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and PDF content can inherit source sensitivity labels and protection. Insider Risk also clarifies alternate-email associations, while two Message Center announcements outline a mid-2027 Endpoint DLP AI capability and a late-November 2026 Edge for Business setup change.

Data Loss Prevention · AI and Copilot

DLP guidance now carries Cowork through location and scope references

The DLP location is now named “Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork,” with Cowork added to setup guidance, examples, and supported experiences. The policy reference also states that administrative-unit scoping applies to Cowork for Microsoft Copilot and Chat.

DSPM · AI and Copilot

DSPM documents sensitivity-label inheritance limits for Copilot content

The guidance says new Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and PDF content can inherit the source item's sensitivity label and protection settings. User-defined-permission labels are unsupported, and labeling does not occur when the label is unavailable to the user or the file exceeds 50 MB.

Insider Risk · General

Insider Risk explains alternate-email profile associations

Insider Risk guidance now says alternate email addresses, including Microsoft Entra ID’s Other mail values, associate activity and historical activity with user profiles. Changing an address does not correct existing alerts or historical associations.

Purview · AI and Copilot

Endpoint DLP AI skills target mid-2027 with Security Copilot required

A Message Center announcement describes AI-powered Policy Sync and Device Health skills for real-time visibility into policy deployment and synchronization issues, impacted devices, root causes, and remediation actions. The rollout is targeted for mid-2027 and requires Security Copilot enabled in the tenant.

Purview · General

Edge for Business DLP setup adds Intune multi-admin approval

Purview DLP setup and activation for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business will gain clearer status, detailed errors, and task coordination between Purview and Intune administrators starting in late November 2026. No policy migration is needed.

View all updates for 10 November 2026 →

item.title: Purview retires four DSPM partner integrations December 7 as permissions auditing expands — 9 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 9 November 2026

Purview retires four DSPM partner integrations December 7 as permissions auditing expands

Microsoft Purview will retire its Varonis, BigID, Cyera, and OneTrust DSPM integrations for non-Microsoft data sources on December 7, 2026. Separately, Purview is adding two audit operations for role-based access control, with worldwide rollout scheduled from late September through mid-November 2026.

Purview · General

Four DSPM partner integrations will retire

On December 7, 2026, Purview will retire the Varonis, BigID, Cyera, and OneTrust integrations for non-Microsoft data sources. They will no longer ingest or display data; other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. Microsoft says no action is required, but administrators should review dependencies if they use these integrations.

Purview · General

RBAC permissions auditing gains two operations

Purview is adding two new audit operations for role-based access control, improving transparency and troubleshooting for access issues. The enhancement is rolling out worldwide from late September through mid-November 2026 and requires no administrator action.

View all updates for 9 November 2026 →

item.title: DLP adds a control to exclude external emails from Copilot grounding — 6 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 6 November 2026

DLP adds a control to exclude external emails from Copilot grounding

A new admin-configurable Purview DLP control is described for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. It restricts processing of email from external or untrusted domains while preserving internal data use. The period also adds more precise auto-label simulation troubleshooting and a new audit activity for gateway datasource status tests.

Purview · AI and Copilot

DLP can exclude external email from Copilot grounding

The Message Center item describes a new admin-configurable DLP control for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. It excludes email from external or untrusted domains from Copilot grounding while maintaining internal data use; the item lists public preview in June 2026 and general availability in June 2027.

Information Protection · Labels and classification

Auto-label guidance adds failure and partial-result handling

The Auto Label Simulation Results article adds the “Simulation failed” status, distinguishes failed jobs from requests that could not start, explains partial workload counts, and provides guidance for reviewing or restarting simulations. Administrators are told to preserve useful results before restarting and review workload details before enabling a policy.

Audit · General

Audit references gateway datasource status test activity

The Audit Log Activities reference now includes GetGatewayClusterDatasourceStatusAsAdmin for tenant administrator connection status tests, giving administrators the activity name needed to identify those tests in audit records.

Information Protection · Labels and classification

Sensitivity-label guidance links simulation failure details

Apply Sensitivity Label Automatically now links to guidance for simulation failure messages and results marked “(partial)”. The change helps administrators find the relevant troubleshooting guidance when simulations fail or produce partial results.

View all updates for 6 November 2026 →

item.title: Purview retention splits Copilot coverage; auto-labeling capped at 500,000 files daily — 5 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 5 November 2026

Purview retention splits Copilot coverage; auto-labeling capped at 500,000 files daily

Two administrator-relevant updates stand out. Beginning January 15, 2027, the “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” retention location will cover Teams content only, while updated Information Protection guidance defines 500,000 automatically labeled SharePoint and OneDrive files per tenant per day as an absolute aggregate ceiling across all auto-labeling policies, not a guaranteed processing rate. Related Purview pages now reflect the same ceiling.

Data Lifecycle · Policies and rules

Teams and Copilot retention coverage separates on January 15, 2027

Policies using “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” will apply only to Teams content beginning January 15, 2027. They will no longer retain or delete Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions, including previously retained interactions. Use the separate “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” location when Copilot retention is required.

Information Protection · Labels and classification

Auto-labeling throughput is an aggregate tenant ceiling, not a rate

The limit for automatically labeled SharePoint and OneDrive files is stated as an absolute maximum of 500,000 files per tenant per day across all auto-labeling policies. Actual throughput may be lower, so administrators should assess volume across the tenant rather than treating the figure as an expected daily processing rate.

View all updates for 5 November 2026 →
